releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8

This update improves graphics accuracy and adds better diagnostic information for investigating driver performance reports.

## General graphics correction

- Corrected a graphics accuracy issue observed as temporary black, blue or multicoloured corruption during the opening of **Fable II**.
- The correction applies automatically and may also help other games affected by similar rendering problems. No additional game setting is required for this correction; existing recommended settings remain available.
- Verified through two opening runs reaching the first childhood gameplay scene on Odin 2. Later scenes, full campaigns and other GPUs still need testing.
- This is an accuracy improvement, with no general FPS increase promised. Brief pauses may still occur when new shaders are prepared.

## Driver diagnostics and session sharing

- Added more useful texture and performance information for investigating reported slowdowns with **RADV on Exynos/Xclipse**.
- Gameplay measurement recordings are now associated with their session and can be included when using **Share session bundle** from Session history.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7

This update brings a general graphics correctness improvement and experimental picture-in-picture support for external media apps.

## Graphics correction

- Fixed the horizontally divided image and missing lower portion observed in the opening real-time cutscene of **Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning**.
- This is a general core correction, applied automatically without additional settings. It may benefit other games affected by similar rendering problems, but wider game and GPU coverage still needs testing.
- Verified through repeated starts and progression to character creation on Odin 2. This does not certify the full campaign or promise a general FPS increase.

## Experimental picture-in-picture

- Keep the game full screen while a compatible external media app uses Android's floating video window.
- Added an app selector with PiP compatibility indicators, an optional media link, and controls in the game menu. Find these options under **Settings → App → Appearance and startup**.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6

Maintenance update focused on optional driver compatibility and updated game recommendations.

- Added an optional experimental texture compatibility setting for RADV on Samsung Xclipse. It is disabled by default and has not yet been verified on Xclipse hardware. Successful driver loading, rendering and performance are not guaranteed; memory use may increase.
- Added recommended settings for **Mobile Suit Gundam: Operation Troy**, restoring the visible world in the first map tested on Odin 2. A complete game copy is required; other devices and the full campaign remain unverified.
- Added recommendations for **Sonic Free Riders with the adapted No Kinect mod**. The compatible adapted mod and its designated launcher are required: settings alone do not repair the original mod, and the mod is not bundled with the app. Menus and two tutorial stages were tested; uneven steering remains under investigation, and full-game compatibility is not confirmed.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5

Maintenance update focused on game loading reliability and clearer driver diagnostics.

- Improved handling of extracted games, disc images and installed game containers.
- Added a per-game startup executable selector for games with multiple launchers.
- Improved reliability when loading additional game modules and title updates, with safer recovery after failed launches.
- Improved recognition of game files and preservation of launch preferences across library updates and shortcuts.
- More precise on-device Vulkan driver diagnostics, including the image check that failed and available error information.

Custom drivers remain device-dependent. More detailed diagnostics help investigate compatibility; they do not guarantee successful RADV loading or fix every game or mod.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.

> [!NOTE]
Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.

### Changelog
- Collected Jinjos will be now be permanently saved when collected, just like Notes. A new option has been added to choose only saving Jinjos or Notes if desired. The new default behavior will be to save both Notes and Jinjos as present in the Xbox 360 version of the game. Special thanks to @wedarobi for their work on this major feature!
- Fixed a major memory leak that would occur on MacOS by updating RT64. The game should now be significantly more stable on extended play sessions on Mac.
- Fixed a build system issue for ARM devices that caused mods, especially total conversion mods, to crash during startup. This should finally make total conversion mods like Nostalgia 64 or Jiggies of Time playable in MacOS devices without requiring to use Rosetta as a workaround.

Fixes for the games reported on GitHub, PlayStation controllers, and the

**Download:** `GenX-v1.1.4-win64.zip`. Unzip it anywhere and run `genx.exe`.

  **Configure → Input** if you already have settings.

  plugged in by themselves for the games that need them.

  Sega CD.

### Fixed

- **Pier Solar** now plays and saves.

  the Mega Drive. Other European games that need a 50Hz console get one.

releases.body:
Play your real Sega CD discs. Nothing else in the emulation changed.

**Download:** `GenX-v1.1.3-win64.zip`. Unzip it anywhere and run `genx.exe`.
To update, replace your old `genx.exe` with the new one. Your settings and
saves stay where they are.

### New

- **Sega CD discs straight from your PC's CD/DVD drive.** Put the disc in,
  choose **File → Open ROM → Sega CD from drive**, and pick the drive. GenX
  reads the game and its CD music from the disc, reading ahead while you play
  so the drive keeps up. A USB drive works too.
- **Changing discs:** use **Sega CD → Swap to disc in drive**, or just put the
  next disc in the drive. GenX swaps it in as a real Sega CD would.
- **Front ends:** `genx.exe E:\` starts the disc in drive E:.

You still need the Sega CD BIOS for the disc's region.

If your drive or a disc doesn't work, please
[open an issue](https://github.com/GamesExObscura/GenX/issues) with the drive's
make and model and the game.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/GamesExObscura/GenX/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for every change.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe isn't code-signed.
Choose **More info → Run anyway**.

  disc sat near a file or folder whose name has certain characters, such as an
  accent stored as a separate mark (some "Pokémon" names) or Japanese text.
- **Japanese and Southeast Asian Sega CD BIOSes now start.** They used to stop
  on an error such as "This is a PAL-compatible Mega CD for exclusive use in
  Southeast Asia", because GenX always presented itself as a US or European
  console. GenX now becomes the console the BIOS belongs to.
- **Japanese discs get a Japanese BIOS** when your BIOS folder also holds the
  Southeast Asian one. Some BIOS packs name the Southeast Asian BIOS
  `jp_mcd1_9112.bin`, which GenX used to pick first.
- The **BIOS** tab in **Configure** shows the BIOS each region's discs will
  really use.

Thanks to the player who reported the Southeast Asia error.

# Steam64 setup, one step at a time

**Experimental prerelease · Build145 · Known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit. This update improves setup; it does not fix that stability issue.**

## What’s new

- **Install Steam64 in the launcher:** downloads the matched Steam/browser packages from Valve over HTTPS, verifies sizes/SHA-256 and installs with rollback. Cancel/retry, Verify/Repair and Return to previous environment are available.
- **Four clear actions:** Install Steam → Connect LocalDevVPN → Pair this device → Enable JIT. Runtime preparation is automatic, signing/address checks remain mandatory, completed steps are checked/skipped and the view follows the next action.
- **Pair in iDeck:** starts the existing on-device pairing immediately with live instructions/PIN, without hunting through JIT settings. iOS calls the pairing host Madeira. Advanced methods/import/recovery/account/auto-start settings are collapsed.
- **Data stays yours:** the original environment remains intact; no auth cache, game or save is silently transferred. Use Valve’s own login and Steam Guard yourself.

## Install and test

**iDeck brings the Steam Big Picture experience to iOS.** Genuine Windows Steam
runs locally through Madeira/Wine/FEX and Metal. This does not install Linux

### What's new since Build 56

# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

> **Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64 only. Distributed as a `.zip` archive. Other platforms are not available yet.

## Highlights

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

releases.name: Open Nectar 1.0.9.1 — Windows ONLY antivirus fix
releases.body:
# Open Nectar 1.0.9.1 — Windows antivirus fix

### **Windows only.** 

Linux, macOS and Android stay on
[1.0.9](https://github.com/SSunnKing/Open-Nectar---Pikmin-Native-PC-Mobile-Port/releases/tag/1.0.9).
Download those from there. Nothing changes in the games themselves.

**Updating:** press **Update** in your launcher. Saves, settings and texture
packs carry over.

## Windows Defender flagged the launcher as a trojan

Some players got a "Threat found" warning from Windows Defender for
`nectar-launcher.exe` (`Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml`). This was a false
positive. The `!ml` means it came from Defender's machine-learning guess,
not from a real malware match.

The launcher was doing things that look suspicious to an antivirus: it
started `curl.exe` and `tar.exe` in the background to download updates and
texture packs, and the exe had no publisher or version info. This release
changes that:

* Downloads now happen inside the launcher instead of through `curl.exe`.
* Update zips are unpacked inside the launcher instead of through `tar.exe`.
* `nectar.exe`, `nectar-pal.exe` and `nectar-launcher.exe` now have
  publisher and version information (right-click → Properties → Details).

releases.name: hakuX 1.3.0
releases.body:
Xbox Live through Insignia, and game fixes.

### Xbox Live
- **Insignia** — Settings → Network → Connection → Xbox Live: Insignia connects the console to Insignia, the revival of the original Xbox Live: Live games sign in, find matches and play online. If your Internet provider blocks Insignia's DNS server, point it at a computer running insigniaDNS instead
- **Xbox Live setup** — Settings → Network → Xbox Live setup walks you through it, one step at a time: the connection, the Xbox dashboard, registering the console with Insignia's Setup Assistant (downloaded for you), then making or recovering your account in the dashboard
- **Dashboard** — the library's Dashboard button (top left) starts the Xbox dashboard from the console's hard disk, where Xbox Live accounts are made and recovered. The first time, it installs the dashboard from a zip of its files (dashboard 5960) that you provide: hakuX doesn't include one
- **Title updates** — a game's Xbox Live update, once downloaded, starts with the game. Forza Motorsport's 60 and 120 fps mods cover its update too

### Games
- **Fable: The Lost Chapters** — the hero's face and arms are no longer black or noise

releases.name: hakuX 1.2.0
releases.body:
System link, stability and compatibility improvements.

### Network
- **System link over your network** — Settings → Network → System link → LAN: hakuX devices on the same Wi-Fi network find each other as Xbox consoles on a LAN do. Devices the network's broadcasts don't reach, on another subnet or a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale, are added by address under Other consoles
- **XLink Kai** — system link over the Internet through an XLink Kai engine running on a computer on your network; its web page picks the game's arena
- **Console identity** — each console has its own serial number, network address and online key. A device whose hard disk was copied from another one offers to make itself a new identity, since two consoles with one identity can't see each other


### Games
- **Sega GT 2002** — the cars have their paint, reflections and sun highlights
- **Doom 3** — no longer crashes as its main menu loads
- **Fatal Frame II** — starts and reads its disc in the order it asks for
- **AirForce Delta Storm** — answers the controller and the on-screen controls (it ignored all input)
- **Silent Hill 2** — no longer crashes when it loads a room

releases.name: hakuX 1.1.0
releases.body:
GPUs beyond Adreno (experimental).

### GPUs
- **Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (experimental)** — hakuX runs on GPUs other than Adreno: features they lack are replaced (BC and 4444 textures decoded up front, standard border colours, the push block in a buffer, D32S8 depth), and known driver bugs are worked around (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`). Burnout 3 and Mercenaries run cleanly on a Pixel 8 (Mali-G715)
- **Vulkan 1.1 drivers** — GPUs whose drivers stop at Vulkan 1.1 (Valhall Mali on older or vendor-capped drivers, Qualcomm's own older drivers, early Xclipse, PowerVR BXM) run through a compatibility layer (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/compat.c`)
- **Older GPUs without descriptor indexing (experimental)** — Bifrost Mali (G71, G72, G76, G52) and PowerVR Rogue: each draw binds its own textures, and depth is clamped in the shader where the GPU can't
- **Adreno** — unchanged: every replacement is off where the GPU has the feature.

### App
- **GPU driver** — a screen of its own (Settings → GPU driver): the system driver and the stored packages in one list, with their versions and authors. Packages are checked when added and can be deleted (deleting the one in use goes back to the system driver)

releases.name: hakuX 1.0.0
releases.body:
A new core replaces xemu's QEMU-based one.

### New core
- **CPU** — the Xbox's x86 code runs on a FEX JIT (FEXCore fork), and the Xbox kernel is reimplemented natively (`native/kernel`): no QEMU
- **GPU** — the NV2A push buffer is decoded into Vulkan (HLE, `hw/xbox/hle`). Custom drivers (Turnip) load through adrenotools; driver-specific workarounds are quirks (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`, `debug.hakux.quirks`)
- **Audio** — the MCPX APU runs on the core's own services (`native/dev/apu`), out through AAudio
- **Savestates** — per game, in slots, with the hard disk's files
- **Mods and cheats** — per game, from `mods/` (library long-press "Mods & cheats"): XBE patches and replaced disc files; 60 and 120 fps mods for 13 games (`mods/README.md`, generators in `tools/mods`)
- **Controllers** — each physical controller routed to a player with its own mapping; the on-screen controller adds to player 1

### New features
- **Updates** — hakuX looks for a newer release on GitHub when it starts and on demand (Settings → Updates); one found shows its notes and installs from there
- **Frontends** — a game launched from ES-DE or another frontend returns to it when it closes

# SeedlessDS 1.1 正式版

版本名为 `1.1`，版本号为 `153`。本次同时发布原包名替换版、共存版、对应源码及 SHA-256 校验文件。两版均关闭 Android 调试标志，正式版本号与发布文件名均不含 debug，测试控制面板关闭。

## 本次改进

- 修复后台存档提前完成时，完成状态被模拟线程覆盖，导致后续快速存档和读档一直被忽略的问题。
- 减少存读档结束后的多余槽位查询、成就附加档读取和目录扫描，成就校验改为流式 SHA-256。
- 拆分即时存档、游戏电池存档和其它文件的访问锁，避免后台慢存档连带阻塞游戏文件读取。后台存档线程降低优先级。
- 防止并发慢查询重新发布已失效的目录列表，修复日志时间格式化的并发访问。
- 在应用私有目录保留有大小上限的近期存读档记录，便于追查偶发卡顿。
- 保留 SoundTouch 原声音高加速、低延迟音频恢复修复，以及按 RP Duo 上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜。

## 安装包选择

| 文件 | Android 包名 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `seedless-ds-1.1-coexist.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` | 可直接更新本分支旧共存版，也可与官方版共存 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-replacement.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app` | 原包名替换版 |
| `seedless-ds-fork-1.1-src.zip` | — | 两版对应的完整源码与构建配置 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-SHA256.txt` | — | 安装包和源码校验值 |

共存版按用户选择保留历史包名中的 `.debug`，以支持覆盖更新，应用本身已关闭调试。两版均沿用本分支旧签名。

替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出存档与配置，再卸载官方版并安装。直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。两个包名的数据各自独立，切换使用时需导入存档。

两版均支持 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`，沿用仓库随源公开测试签名。

## 验证范围

- 两种正式构建各 128 项应用测试通过，完成构建、Lint、包名和签名检查，并核对 `debuggable=false`、`testOnly=false` 及 `BuildConfig.DEBUG=false`。两版的应用资源和原生库一致。
- 原生回归覆盖 21 类存档故障、280 轮重复存读档及请求交错。

# Swap2-Native 0.1.9.3-beta

Swap2-Native now speaks the Switch 2's 16 languages, works with a controller from the library to the in-game panel, has a redesigned in-game panel, and offers a frame rate cap in every game.

**Install over 0.1.9.1-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## New

- **The app in 16 languages.** Every menu, dialog and the in-game panel follow your phone's language: English (US and UK), Japanese, French (France and Canada), German, Italian, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Dutch, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional). To use another one, pick it in **Settings › Interface › App language** (or in Android's own app language setting).
- **Controller navigation.** In the library, with a game selected: **A** plays it, **Y** opens its Game settings, **L / R** switch tabs. Buttons follow the Nintendo layout (A right, B bottom) by default; **Settings › Interface** keeps the Xbox layout if you prefer it.

Turned off, the game's mesh-drawn geometry is not drawn: in Zelda that is much of the foliage, the falling leaves and some objects. # Swap2-Native 0.1.8.9-beta

The frame rate cap of Zelda: Ocarina of Time can be chosen again, so the game keeps real time.

**Install over 0.1.8.8-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## Fixed

- **Zelda's frame rate cap was greyed out.** Its Game settings and the in-game panel said the game picks its own frame rate and offered no cap. A Zelda left at "The game's own" then moved forward 1/30 of a second each frame, so below 30 fps it ran in slow motion (about 0.7 of real time at 21 fps on our POCO F7 Ultra).
  - The cap now offers **30 fps** and **60 fps** for Zelda again, in its Game settings and in the in-game panel. Pick 30 fps (the default) to keep real time; 0.1.8.8-beta's fix makes it hold down to 20 fps.
  - Switching back to "The game's own" while the game runs now takes effect at once.
- If Zelda still runs slowly after updating, open Zelda once: the app then sees the new cap choices. Then set **Frame rate cap** to **30 fps** or **Default** in Zelda's Game settings.

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.8.8-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.8-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time no longer runs in slow motion where the phone cannot hold 30 fps.

**Install over 0.1.8.7-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change: if you already updated them for 0.1.8.7-beta, nothing is translated again.

## Fixed

- **Slow motion below 30 fps with the 30 fps cap.** Where the phone drew fewer than 30 frames a second, each frame still moved the game forward by only 1/30 of a second, so the game ran slower than real time. It now moves the game forward by 1/20 of a second there, and the game keeps real time.
  - On our test phone (POCO F7 Ultra), Kokiri Forest by the scarecrow: before, about 22 fps at three quarters of real time; now a steady 20 fps at real time, with fewer stutters. By Mido: 30 fps, as before.
  - The 60 fps setting and the uncapped setting are unchanged.

## Tips

- **Frame generation** (Settings › Performance, with your own Lossless.dll) works well with the 30 fps cap on the POCO F7 Ultra: it costs about half a frame a second by the scarecrow and shows twice the frames on screen.

## If your game stops

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.8.7-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.7-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time runs faster where there is a lot of grass and foliage, and the app uses less memory in a few places.

**Install over 0.1.8.6-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept.

**Zelda's shaders are updated once after installing.** Only the 500 shaders of grass and foliage change. The app starts the update by itself when you open Zelda and does it in the background: about 30 minutes on our POCO F7 Ultra (most of it reading the game's shaders again). You can play during the update with the old shaders; the gain below comes once it finishes. Keep the phone charging.

## Faster

- **Grass and foliage in Zelda: Ocarina of Time.** The game draws them with mesh shaders, which phones run through compute. Those computes kept every output in a slow on-chip copy, and the GPU could keep only a few of them busy at once. They now write their outputs straight to memory.
  - On our test phone (POCO F7 Ultra), Kokiri Forest by the scarecrow: about 18.6 fps before, 22.8 now. By Mido: 34 fps before, 41.9 now. The picture is the same.

releases.body:
# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 341 (9c9a1df)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 316 (5a66c89)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 228

Built from nx2 at 5a66c8959f, the release candidate testers have been running (run 316). Build 228 was be1f4d9c84. That's 141 merged changes, 60 of them from community contributors.

### Big points
- **Nextendo online play (opt-in).** Lichii can now play online through the Nextendo Network. It's off until you turn it on: Configure → Network → Play online through Nextendo Network, then sign in (#1979, #1358, #1984).
  - **Friends list, friend requests and presence:** see who is online and add friends (#1983, #2019).
  - **Your Nextendo nickname and picture** show as the current user (#1990).
  - **One Nextendo account per user profile:** each Lichii user profile signs in on its own. If you were already signed in, you may need to sign in once more (#2011).
  - **Network fixes so games stay connected:** Splatoon 3's network requests follow the connection (#1988). Socket options games use are handled, and stray UDP resets on Windows are ignored (#1982). SSL Peek returns the waiting bytes (#2016).
  - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe must be on version 4.0.1 to play online.

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 228 (be1f4d9)

Built from nx2 9fbffe253b plus 11 pull requests that merged into nx2 after it (the test/all-in-one-3 branch at be1f4d9c84). Build 177 was 87d84d513c. That's 152 merged changes, 69 of them from community contributors.

> **The first launch of each game after updating takes longer.** A lot of shader code changed in this release, so caches are partly rebuilt once: the compute precache runs its pass once more (#1620), pipelines that an older cache saved with the wrong texture type are rebuilt (#1443), NVIDIA on Linux fills a new, larger driver cache folder (#1301), and the LSFG shader cache rebuilds (#1625). Later launches should be fast again. If a second launch of the same build still rebuilds most shaders, send the log from Help → Report a Bug (Ctrl+F12): we're looking into reports of this.

## Changes since build 150

Built from nx2 2eb5f081c8. Build 150 was 17baed7. That's 30 merged changes.

> **New look.** Lichii now opens in the new **Lichii Dark** theme, and a short **What's new** window explains what moved. You can reopen it from **Help → What's New**, and the old themes are still in the settings.

### Big fixes
- **Yoshi and the Mysterious Book: the 3D world renders.** Three shader forms the game uses were rejected, which left the world black. Built on ggonzalospineli-ops' #1189 and FrsrG's #1284, with ALD/OUT from MythosOfs (#1363).

- **Mario Kart World: characters and karts are lit correctly.** Read-only compute bindings are sized from their size word (#1333).

## GEARMASS — распределение нагрузки (`runtime/gearmass.c`)
Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах
они живут, сколько кадров CPU готовит вперёд и как поднимать качество, пока GPU свободен. **Никаких списков
телефонов и компьютеров**: всё выводится из топологии (число ядер, их частоты из `cpufreq`) и из замеров во время
игры.

Режимы (`ME1_GEARMASS`, лаунчеры → «Нагрузка (GEARMASS)» → «Режим нагрузки», `me1port.ini` `[Port] Gearmass`):

## Что нового

  точная эмуляция float D3D9 (без чёрных и белых точек).
- Установка через `linux/install.sh` (ярлык, иконка, удаление через `--uninstall`).

- Два скрипта в корне исходников — `build-linux.sh` и `build-android.sh` (справка по `-h`).
- Сами находят игру (Steam, в том числе Flatpak и Snap, `~/Games`, `~/GOG Games`, папки Wine) или берут её из `--game`.
- Сами находят `msvcr80`, `msvcp80` и `d3dx9_31`: в папке игры, префиксах Proton и Wine, на разделе Windows или

releases.name: Pocket Foundry 0.9.3-beta.2
releases.body:
**Beta, for testing.** Install it by hand, or turn on Include prereleases for Pocket Foundry in Obtainium. It updates to the release once that's out.

Play your own copy of Factorio on Android: the official Linux ARM64 build, run without emulation on the phone's GPU.

**Install:** open `pocket-foundry-0.9.3-beta.2.apk` on the phone (Android 10 or later) and import the Linux (arm64) .tar.xz from [factorio.com/download](https://factorio.com/download). Pocket Foundry then asks before downloading a driver for your GPU from pocket-foundry-drivers: Turnip on Adreno 6xx or newer, experimental builds on some Mali and Xclipse GPUs, Phone's OpenGL ES (MobileGlues) or the CPU elsewhere. Without downloads it plays through Phone's Vulkan (experimental) or an imported one. The app holds no part of Factorio: you bring your own copy. A new version installs over the last and keeps the game and saves; from 0.8, 0.9 installs as a new app next to the old one and brings its saves, mods and config over.
